data.long_meaning: Safiwah is derived from the Arabic word 'safi', which means 'pure'. It is a unisex name, but more commonly given to girls. The name Safiwah carries the meaning “Pure” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Safiwah usually hope their child will grow to embody pure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
